app.handheld: Kydux is made for a computer, with a keyboard and a mouse. On a phone or a tablet, some things may not work well.
app.title: Kydux

outcome.incomplete: Not yet: {n} of {total} goals met. Try again.
outcome.walked_over: The wizard walked right over the mark without stopping! The program needs to end with the wizard standing exactly on it.
outcome.too_many_ticks: Your program has taken more than {limit} steps and the wizard is tired. Is there a loop that never ends?
outcome.interrupted: Your program was stopped: it ran for more than {seconds} seconds without doing anything.
outcome.caught: The teacher saw you! Try again, and watch which way they look.
outcome.way_won: The wizard gets through this way. Not every way yet: choose another one to see it.

level.failed: Python could not start. Reload the page to try again.
level.load_failed: The level could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
level.last: That is all for now. More levels are coming.
level.split: Drag to resize the scene and the editor
level.run_key: Run your code: Alt+R, or Ctrl+Enter in the editor
level.notebook_key: Open or close the notebook: Alt+N
level.ways: This level is played {n} ways. One program must get through them all:
level.kind_fix: This program does not work yet. Find what is wrong, and fix it.
level.kind_improve: This program works, but it can be better. Make it better.

error.read_only: You cannot change `{object}.{name}` yourself. An action changes it.
error.not_called: `{name}` is an action. An action is done with brackets after it, like `{example}`.
error.unclosed: This line opens a `{what}` that never closes.
error.missing_colon: A line that starts with `{keyword}` ends with `:`.
error.indentation: The lines inside a `while`, an `if` or a `for` need four spaces in front.
error.arguments: `{name}` is not used like that. Try it like this: `{example}`.
error.no_such_module: There is no book called `{name}` in the school's library.
error.unknown_action: `{object}` does not know an action called `{name}`.
error.no_new_attribute: You cannot give `{object}` a new `{name}`. What `{object}` can do is in its notebook.

blocked.friend: {name} is in my way: I must walk round.
blocked.locked: I cannot open {thing}: it is locked, and I have no key for it.
blocked.open: I do not need to: {thing} is already open.
blocked.nothing: There is nothing here to pick up.
blocked.unknown_action: I do not know this action yet.
blocked.no_wand: I do not know this action yet.
blocked.unknown_spell: I do not know a spell called “{spell}”.
blocked.sealed: I cannot open {thing} by hand: it is sealed, and needs a spell.
blocked.password: I cannot open {thing} by hand: it wants a word.
blocked.nothing_near: There is nothing near enough for the spell to bring.
blocked.not_carried: I cannot give {thing}: I am not carrying it.
blocked.nobody: There is no one beside me to give it to.
blocked.which_one: There are several things here: {things}. Say which, like wizard.pick_up({first}).
blocked.unheard: While its seal holds, {thing} cannot hear a word.
blocked.not_my_dormitory: I should not go into the {girls'|boys'} dormitory.
blocked.not_now_outside: Now is not a good time to leave the castle.
blocked.no_bed: There is no bed right beside me.
blocked.bed_taken: This bed belongs to someone else.
blocked.not_here: I am carrying {thing}, so it cannot be shown where it lies.

wizard.move_right: Walks right, one tile per step. Stops at a wall or a closed door.
wizard.move_left: Walks left, one tile per step. Stops at a wall or a closed door.
wizard.move_up: Walks up, one tile per step. Stops at a wall or a closed door.
wizard.move_down: Walks down, one tile per step. Stops at a wall or a closed door.
wizard.wait: Stands still while the world moves on, one tick at a time.
wizard.pick_up: Picks up a thing on the wizard's tile or beside it, and carries it. With several in reach, say which: wizard.pick_up(key).
wizard.find_nearest: Finds the nearest thing of a kind, or None when there is none.
wizard.find_all: Finds every thing of a kind, nearest first.
wizard.has: Tells whether the wizard carries a thing of a kind.
wizard.position: Where the wizard stands, as x and y.
wizard.facing: The way the wizard looks: up, down, left or right.
wizard.cast: Casts a spell with the wand, which the wizard must carry. What a spell does depends on where the wizard stands and what is near; it may do nothing at all.
wizard.give: Gives a thing the wizard carries to whoever stands right beside it.
wizard.sleep: Lies down and sleeps in a free bed.
wizard.distance_to: Gives the number of steps from the wizard to an object.

thing.kind: What the thing is, like "key" or "book".
thing.name: The thing's own name in this level.
thing.position: Where the thing lies, or None once the wizard carries it.
thing.distance_to: Gives the number of steps from an object to the wizard.
thing.reveal: Shows where a hidden thing lies.

door.name: The door's own name in this level.
door.position: Where the door stands, as x and y.
door.locked: True while the door needs its key to open.
door.is_open: True once the door is open, and the wizard can go through.
door.open: Opens the door. The wizard must stand next to it, and carry its key if it is locked. A sealed door, or one with a password, does not open by hand.
door.sealed: True while the door is sealed, until its spell is cast beside it.
door.password: The word that opens the door when it is said beside it, or None.
door.distance_to: Gives the number of steps from an object to the wizard.
door.reveal: Shows where a hidden thing lies.

key.name: The key's own name in this level.
key.position: Where the key lies, or None once the wizard carries it.
key.distance_to: Gives the number of steps from an object to the wizard.
key.reveal: Shows where a hidden thing lies.

teacher.name: The teacher's own name in this level.
teacher.position: Where the teacher stands, as x and y.
teacher.facing: The way the teacher looks: up, down, left or right.
teacher.can_see: Tells whether the teacher can see something straight ahead, close enough.
teacher.distance_to: Gives the number of steps from an object to the wizard.

ghost.name: The ghost's name in this level.
ghost.position: Where the ghost floats, in x and y.
ghost.facing: The way the ghost looks: up, down, left or right.
ghost.distance_to: Gives the number of steps from an object to the wizard.

cat.name: The cat's name in this level.
cat.position: Where the cat sits, in x and y.
cat.facing: The way the cat looks: up, down, left or right.
cat.distance_to: Gives the number of steps from an object to the wizard.

stair.name: The stair's own name in this level.
stair.position: Where the stair is, in x and y.
stair.in_place: True when a step onto the stair, taken now, lands on it.
stair.distance_to: Gives the number of steps from an object to the wizard.
stair.reveal: Shows where a hidden thing lies.

bed.name: The bed's own name in this level.
bed.position: Where the bed stands, in x and y.
bed.free: True when no one sleeps in the bed.
bed.distance_to: Gives the number of steps from an object to the wizard.
bed.reveal: Shows where a hidden thing lies.

start.welcome: Welcome to the school of magic
start.intro: You have just arrived at the school. Every step you take here, you take by writing Python.
start.saved: Your game is saved as you play.
start.delete_confirm: Delete {name}'s game? It cannot be brought back.
start.progress_about: Your games are kept in this browser. To take the one you are playing to another computer, export it to a file and import it there.
start.import_failed: That file is not a Kydux progress file. Nothing has changed.

map.leave_run: Your program is still running. Leave the level?

run.does: Runs your code. On a Mac, Cmd+Enter or Option+R.

notebook.does: Opens or closes the notebook. On a Mac, Option+N.

indent.does: Moves a line in by four spaces, or out again.

leave.does: Leaves the editor, so that Tab moves to the next button.

close.does: Closes a card over the scene.

split.does: On the handle between the scene and the editor, moves it.

wizard.title: Your wizard
wizard.name: Your wizard's name
wizard.name_rule: A name has letters, digits, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes, up to 20 of them.
wizard.name_taken: That name belongs to someone or something in the game. Choose another.
wizard.gender_first: Choose first who your wizard is, and their looks appear here.

wizard.move_right: Walks one step to the right.
wizard.move_left: Walks one step to the left.
wizard.wait: Stands still for one tick, while the world goes on.

stars.kept: You keep the {n} stars you had.

spells.zelim: breaks the seal of a door beside you.
spells.fendra: draws to your tile the nearest thing up to three tiles away in a straight line.
spells.kirra: lights the dark room you are in.
spells.osto: holds a moving stair beside you still for a while.

words.ambrel: the school's word, which opens its gates.
